0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_TALK_ACTOR_02
0.description: ...<hex:022903EA0203>, was it? If that is your desire, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, then it shall be done.

1.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_001_Q1
1.description: Retire <hex:022903EA0203>?<hex:02100103>※Retired chocobos cannot be re-registered as race chocobos.

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_001_01
4.description: I see you are resolved. Very well. What parting words have you for your chocobo?

5.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_001_02
5.description: Praising a chocobo's acquired ability will transform it into a hereditary ability, which can be passed down through generations.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_002_A2
8.description: Fare thee well, old friend. I'll never forget you─nor your mastery of <hex:022818FF1343686F636F626F526163654162696C697479E8020103>, and how it carried us to victory!

9.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_002_A3
9.description: No, not yet! I am not ready to say good-bye!

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_002_01
10.description: ...Your chocobo shall enjoy a life of luxury─of that you can be assured.

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_002_02
11.description: As a reminder, take care not to misplace your retired chocobo registration form.

12.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_002_03
12.description: Should you wish to arrange a covering, you will need to present it to Katering at Moogle's Gift Mounts.

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_RETIRE_003_01
13.description: Very well. You needn't concern yourself with this one any longer.

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_ERROR_001_01
14.description: Begging your pardons, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, but your hands seem rather full at the moment. Mayhap you should see to your possessions before discussing this matter with me.

15.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_ERROR_001_02
15.description: You cannot retire a chocobo without space in your inventory to store the retired chocobo registration form.

16.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_TALK_ACTOR
16.description: If that is your desire, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, then it shall be done.

17.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_ERROR_002_01
17.description: How odd. You did say you wished to retire a chocobo, did you not? Yet according to my records, you do not have a race chocobo registered.

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACERETIRE_00232_ERROR_002_02
18.description: Only a registered race chocobo with a rank of 40 or higher can be retired.
